data.one_liner: System-wide desktop and in-app hardware-keyboard shortcuts for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter desktop and Android apps to register system-wide global shortcuts and in-app keyboard shortcuts. It provides helper widgets like a hotkey recorder and handles platform-specific key events and modifiers.
use_when: You need global system-wide shortcuts for a desktop Flutter app on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
You need in-app hardware keyboard shortcuts for desktop or Android apps.
avoid_when: You are targeting web platforms (not supported).
You only need standard widget-level focus shortcuts that do not require hardware key or global capture.
strengths: Supports multiple desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux including Wayland portal support) and Android in-app.
Provides both system-wide and in-app shortcut scopes.
weaknesses: System-wide shortcuts are not supported on Android.
Requires specific platform configurations and permissions (e.g., Wayland portal or macOS accessibility/media tap permissions).
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring proper initialization, handling platform-specific permissions (like macOS Quartz event taps for media keys), and installing required Linux desktop portal providers for Wayland.
